definition: A tall plant with a thick trunk, branches and leaves.
example: The bird built a nest in the tree.

options.text: A small flower in a pot
A tall plant with a trunk and leaves

explanation: A tree has a trunk, branches and leaves. Good job!

definition: To push yourself up off the ground into the air.
example: I can jump over the puddle.

options.text: To push yourself up into the air

explanation: When you jump, your feet leave the ground. Nice one!

definition: A person you like and enjoy spending time with.
example: My friend shared her crayons with me.

options.text: A person you like to spend time with

explanation: A friend is someone you like and play with. Great job!

definition: The clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and lakes.
example: I drink a glass of water every day.
explanation: Water is the clear liquid we drink and swim in. Well done!

definition: A small furry animal with long ears that hops.

options.text: A large animal with a trunk
A small furry animal with long ears

explanation: A rabbit has long ears and hops. You got it!

definition: The color of a lemon or the sun.

options.text: The color of a leaf in summer

explanation: Yellow is the bright color of lemons. Great job!

definition: A thin tool you write or draw with that has a point and an eraser.
example: I wrote my name with a pencil.

options.text: A soft toy for a baby
A thin tool for writing and drawing

explanation: You can write and draw with a pencil. Nice work!

definition: An opening in a wall with glass that lets in light.
example: I looked out the window at the snow.

options.text: A glass opening in a wall

explanation: A window lets light in and lets you see outside. Well done!

definition: A group of people who are related and live together, like parents and children.

options.text: Animals that live in the sea
People who are related and live together
A group of cars on a road

explanation: A family is a group of people who care for each other. Great job!

definition: A very large gray animal with big ears and a long trunk.
example: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk.

options.text: A bird with a long beak
A huge gray animal with a long trunk

explanation: An elephant is a huge animal with a trunk. Wow!

definition: Drops of water that fall from clouds.
example: We wore boots because of the rain.

options.text: Tiny pieces of white ice that float
Drops of water that fall from clouds

explanation: Rain is water falling from the clouds. Great work!

definition: A happy look on your face where the corners of your mouth turn up.
example: She gave me a big smile.

options.text: A happy look with your mouth turned up

explanation: A smile shows you are happy. Nice job!
